name: Sameer Reddy
card: Sameer Reddy is a forty-one-year-old hospital pharmacist in Hyderabad who shops on his Android phone. He found the marketplace on his own over a year ago and has reached platinum loyalty, with points still waiting to be used. He mostly buys household staples like atta, basmati rice, desi ghee, masala chai and dry fruits, and also browses fashion and electronics. He visits often but has ordered only twice lately, never returned anything, and sometimes leaves a cart without buying. Of twenty-four past offers, he claimed sixteen, used twelve and dismissed two.
